verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has a dedicated self-hosting guide describing running and managing the platform on your own infrastructure (docs-17). The CLI explicitly supports self-hosting (docs-16), and the product is open source with a public GitHub repo (docs-2, gh-1, probe-1). missing for 10: detail on deployment methods (e.g. Docker/Kubernetes) and requirements, clarity on feature parity with Cloud, independent hands-on corroboration of a successful self-hosted deployment.
